_comment: Hand-written loot bags the rarity list does not cover. key = file name of the custom image / sound (config/telemetric/bags/<key>.png|.gif|.ogg|.wav); totem = item model path of the drop pop (telos:<totem>); sound = suffix of the drop sound (noise:player.bags.create_<sound>); model = custom model with the image screen (assets/telemetric/models/bags/<model>.json); group = Lifetime Stats row (default: key). A key that is also a rarity replaces the guessed bag. From Melinoe's bag list.
